title: Ohne-Makler Listing Details Scraper
description: Extract an Ohne-Makler listing’s asking price, rooms, area, condition, location, photos, energy details, and description. Batch listing IDs for property research.

batch.title: Listing IDs
batch.description: Ohne-Makler numeric IDs or OM-prefixed object numbers.
batch.valueDescription: Ohne-Makler listing identifier used for this detail lookup.

schema.description: Listing id: numeric (498791) or object number (OM-498791).

listing.title: Bright two-bedroom flat in Berlin
listing.description: Bright two-bedroom home with a balcony near local transport.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Get Ohne-Makler property details by listing ID, including asking price, rooms, area, condition, energy data, location, and photos. Batch IDs for analysis.
storeCopy.intro: Retrieve an Ohne-Makler listing by numeric ID or object number. The record includes asking price, room count, area, condition, energy information, location, gallery, and description.
useCases: Property buyers can review full details for listings found in search.
Investors can compare asking price, area, and construction year across properties.
Housing analysts can enrich listing IDs with location and energy fields.
howToUse: Add a numeric ID or OM-prefixed object number to `listing_ids`.
Set `maxResults` to cap the number of detailed property records.
Export one complete listing record for each ID.

faqs.question: Can I use an object number instead of a numeric ID?
faqs.answer: Yes. The input accepts a numeric listing ID or an object number such as an OM-prefixed value.
